description: Pure-Python (no TF) calibrated memory model (R3, design sections 2.1-2.5 and 4.1-4.6): checked-in calibration data models/memory_calibration.json, models/memory_model.py (Workload, architecture-derived tensor inventory with phases F/Fw/Fb/I/D/E/Z/V, skip-gradient term, limit_flags incl. the build forward, predict, fit with OOM hinge, leave-one-mode-out, hold-out gate, grid, recommend with per-N table/T rule/exit codes, step-time model), scripts/memory_model.py CLI writing models/memory_coefficients.json, scripts/step_times_from_metrics.py, and their TF-free tests. Plan items 9-12. Depends on FEAT-001 only for models/width_presets.py (count_params, PRESETS); otherwise independent of the TF code.
steps: Plan item 9: create models/memory_calibration.json. Transcribe requirements section 2 level-2 deform points (RTX 8000, cascade, lncc true: fp32 none N2/3/4 + N6 oom; fp32 integrator N2/4/6; fp32 both N2/3/4/6; AMP none N2/4/6; AMP integrator N2/4/6/8; AMP both N2/4/6/8), level-2 linear (fp32 N4/8 ok, N12 status failed_d2; AMP N4/8/12/16; build_n = n), level-4 A6000 default fp32 none N8/12/16 (lncc false, milestone 6), GTX 1080 default/narrow points incl. OOMs read from .agents/tasks/milestone-6/memory.json, the LNCC on/off points from .agents/tasks/lncc-loss/memory.json, and the level-4 linear N32 26-34 GB 'range' point. Each record: source, gpu, cap_gib, status (ok|oom|failed_d2|range|holdout), measure 'peak_mb', lncc, cascade, build_n, plus workload fields (level, task, n, widths or explicit filters/decoder widths, checkpointing, amp, integration_steps, knobs). Read the two local JSONs to get exact MB values and configurations.

Plan item 10: implement models/memory_model.py (stdlib + numpy; scipy.optimize.least_squares imported only inside fit; Python 3.8 syntax) exactly per design 2.1 (block inventories 5*C_in / 4*C_in + C_in/N with split / head 4*C fp32 under AMP; sampler costs 84+32C default; lean retained 12(+12), T_fwd 84+32C+168 int64, forward moment 252+36C, T_bwd 88+8C(+16C)); sampler call records (name, C, share, images_grad, term, order) in deform_loss program order; phases F (c_loss weighting), Fw (timed rule; fwd_transient_bound=True = 'order-independent estimate (one overlapping sampler forward)', plan NIT N3), Fb, I, D (per decoder-block sub-phases with B_sg; skip_grad_bound=True conservative), E, Z (chain42), V (val_pair_chunk); resident per touched part (U16) using width_presets.count_params; limit_flags (bwd bound 2^31-1 both precisions, fwd bound 2^31-1 fp32 / 3.52e9 fp16, --tensor-limits override, build forward at build_n default min(n,2)); predict(workload, coeffs, margin=0.0, skip_grad_bound=False, fwd_transient_bound=False) returning the design 4.1 fields (docstring: setting either flag True selects its conservative variant, NIT N1); coefficient table of 4.3 with bounds/initials; fit (soft_l1, f_scale 0.05, OOM hinge max(0, 0.98*cap - pred)/cap, exit 1 on any ok point outside +-15% or oom predicted feasible or failed_d2 unflagged; prints accuracy table, leave-one-mode-out for the six level-2 groups, hold-out table, warmup_excess_gib); hold-out gate (|err| <= 20%, margin m = max(0.15, max|holdout err|)); grid (full R3.4 grid); recommend (4.4 steps 1-6: AMP+full at level 1, presets x knob subsets x T x N 2..8, feasibility a-d, per-N table under timed rule AND both bounds, tie-breaks params > T rule > fewer knobs > step time, T rule with --t6-verdict (missing/false -> T6 excluded + warning), --n-target default 4, N*, exit 3 with R3.7 verdict, exit 4 on hold-out gate bypass, --margin, --print-env, recommendation.json with all 4.4 fields PLUS NIT N4 fields level1.deform_peak_fwd_bound_gib, deform_peak_fwd_bound_margin_gib, bound_alt_knobs and level1.a100.deform_n_no_margin_fwd_bound, level2/level4 pinned recipes flagged if infeasible, PROVISIONAL line); step-time model 4.5 (a/b/t0 per GPU, r_task ratios, m7 consistency check +-20% -> scalar s, +-50% ranges, long-run wall time with >72 h / >7 d flags). CLI scripts/memory_model.py {fit,predict,grid,recommend} with --calibration/--coefficients/--out; fit writes models/memory_coefficients.json.

Plan item 11: tests/test_memory_model.py (no TF; assert 'tensorflow' not in sys.modules) covering every bullet of design 4.6: calibration within +-15% and OOM/failed infeasible; leave-one-mode-out printed; hold-out gate (skip with message while no holdout records exist; must run after FEAT-004); presets reproduced by uniform and count_params stable; level-1 grid/per-N/recommendation printed (N >= 4 at <= 44 GiB incl. frozen + validation, or R3.7 verdict); recommendation.json fields incl. N4 fields; T6 exclusion/selection branches on synthetic predictions; m8 recipe within 15% of 27.8 GB; limit_flags cases (f0d1 unsplit N4 flagged, split passes; f0d1 split N6 build_n 2 unflagged vs build_n 6 flagged; m8 linear fp32 N12 build flagged); build_n never changes peak_gib; level-2 linear table pre-fit within 0.05 GiB; pre-fit pins (six level-2 deform rows within 0.1 GiB with B_sg: fp32 none 18.5/26.7/35.0, fp32 integrator 15.1/29.3/43.6, fp32 both 12.5/18.3/24.1/35.8, AMP none 13.8/25.6/39.6, AMP integrator 10.4/19.9/29.4/38.9, AMP both 7.7/14.5/21.3/28.2; f0d1 LS N4 33.5 +-0.1 phase D, Fw 32.0 +-0.2, Fb 25.5 +-0.2); Fw/Fb rules (Fw-resident = N*(shared+936 B); bound Fw-F = N*554 B, lean losses N*698 B; Fb = F - N*54 B / F + N*90 B; lean I uses 172 B / 360 B; no lean -> Fw=Fb=0); bounds f0d1 LS N4 41.0 +-0.2, LLS 35.0 +-0.3, skip bound 34.9 +-0.1; per-N table timed rule: no feasible row with margin at N >= 5, N4 row f0d1 LS; LNCC on-off diff >= 0 and <= 5% for c_loss in [0,1]; resident linear-only excludes deform slots; fake-calibration OOM-feasible -> fit exit 1 naming the point, hinge 0 above 0.98 cap; skip-gradient term cases; step-time chain synthetic; calibration schema check.

Plan item 12: new TF-free scripts/step_times_from_metrics.py (--runs, --min-step 1000, --extra-keys, --args-keys, --out; per run over records with step >= min-step: median/IQR/window count of time/compute_ms and each train_<task>/compute_ms; per_task flag; extra keys matched with/without train_<task>/ prefix -> median and max of window means, null if absent; --args-keys copied from config.json args, null if missing; missing run/metrics/config marked missing; unparsable lines counted and skipped; exit 0). New tests/test_step_times.py with two fake run dirs (cascade-style with train_rigid/train_deform compute_ms and train_deform/diag_u_res_max_vox; non-cascade with time/compute_ms only), a fake config.json and a missing run.

Run `python scripts/memory_model.py fit` to generate models/memory_coefficients.json; run recommend into .agents/tasks/milestone-9/recommendation_prefit.json (local outputs never go to the repo's scratch/, it is not git-ignored) and note the per-N table in findings.
py_compile + ast feature_version=(3,8) in bgr_preproc38 on all new files.
acceptance_criteria: AC7: python -m unittest tests.test_memory_model passes (no TF imported): every ok calibration point within +-15%, every OOM/failed point infeasible, leave-one-mode-out errors printed.

AC8 (pre-measurement): `python scripts/memory_model.py recommend` prints the level-1 grid summary, the per-N table under the timed rule and both bounds, and a recommendation with deform N >= 4 at <= 44 GiB incl. frozen stages and validation (expected f0d1 LS N4 ~33.5 GiB), or the R3.7 verdict with exit 3.
`python scripts/memory_model.py fit` exits 0 and writes models/memory_coefficients.json; no fitted coefficient silently at a bound (reported if so).
recommendation.json contains every field of design 4.4 step 6 plus the NIT N4 fields.
tests/test_step_times.py passes in bgr_preproc38 and tf_gpu.
All new files pass py_compile and ast feature_version=(3,8) in bgr_preproc38.

findings: ALL FEAT-002 verification commands pass; not committed (per instructions). FILES new: models/memory_model.py (TF-free, imports neither tensorflow nor scipy at module level; scipy.optimize.least_squares only inside fit_coefficients), models/memory_calibration.json (54 records: 45 ok, 8 oom, 1 failed_d2, 1 range; plus a step_times section), models/memory_coefficients.json (generated by `python scripts/memory_model.py fit`), scripts/memory_model.py (CLI fit/predict/grid/recommend), scripts/step_times_from_metrics.py, tests/test_memory_model.py, tests/test_step_times.py; local output .agents/tasks/milestone-9/recommendation_prefit.json. No existing file changed (tests/run_tests_wsl.sh additions are plan item 16, not done here). VERIFICATION: bgr_preproc38 `python -m unittest tests.test_memory_model tests.test_step_times tests.test_width_presets -v` -> 44 OK, 1 skip (hold-out gate, no hold-out records yet), 16 s, tensorflow not in sys.modules; tf_gpu `tests.test_memory_model tests.test_step_times` -> 36 OK, 1 skip, 14.5 s (adds ~30 s to the suite); fit in tf_gpu gives the same coefficients (max diff 4e-8); goldens '[golden] max |diff| 0 (tolerance 0)' and '[golden deform] max |diff| 0 (tolerance 0)' (112 s); py_compile + ast (3,8) OK on the 5 new .py files in bgr_preproc38. FIT (exit 0, 2.6 s incl. 6 leave-one-mode-out refits): c_net 0.999, c_enc32 1.064, c_enc16 0.749, c_loss 0.531, c_rec 0.912, c_warp 1.197, c_bwd 2.694, c0_cluster 0.103 GiB, c0_gtx1080 0.090 GiB; NO coefficient at a bound (c_enc16 0.75 is below the design's expected 0.89 but inside [0.6, 1.6]). Accuracy: 45 ok points -3.7 ... +2.1 % fitted (pre-fit -9.5 ... +13.7 %); every OOM predicted > cap (marginal one: GTX narrow none N6 5.94 vs cap 5.86 GiB); l2 linear fp32 N12 failed_d2 flagged by the build forward (build/d2 group concat 12x80x112x96x256 fp32 2.64e9 > 2^31-1); range point l4 linear N32 predicted 22.1 GiB (<= 34 upper containment ok; below the 26 lower end, unverified source, U14). LOMO errors: fp32_none -0.2..+0.9 %, fp32_integrator +1.6..+2.6 %, fp32_both +1.5..+2.5 %, amp_none -2.8..+0.6 %, amp_integrator -2.8..-0.9 %, amp_both -6.5..-4.6 %. warmup_excess_gib 0.207. Hold-out: none yet -> margin 0.15; test_holdout_gate skips with a message and MUST run after FEAT-004 adds status 'holdout' records (fields: all workload fields + id/source/gpu/cap_gib/measure 'peak_mb'/lncc/cascade/build_n, status 'holdout', measured_status 'ok'|'oom', peak_mb for ok; validate_calibration enforces this). After adding them re-run `python scripts/memory_model.py fit` (test_coefficients_file_current fails on a stale coefficients file). RECOMMENDATION (fitted coefficients, margin 0.15, T6 excluded without --t6-verdict; exit 0): f0d1 (filters 16,64,128,192,256,384 / decoder 128,96,64,32,8), AMP, full, lean sampler + split, lean losses off, T 7; level-1 deform N* 4 at 34.99 GiB (40.24 with margin), phase D; 5 without the margin; order-independent estimate 38.60 GiB (44.39 with margin -> bound alternative {lean_losses: true}); A100: deform N 3 with margin / 4 without / 3 without under the bound; linear N 16 at 13.51 GiB; val_pair_chunk 16 (12 pairs); level 2 m8 recipe deform N8 25.57 GiB, linear N16 7.26 GiB (largest A100 deform N both 9 / full 13); level 4 m7 recipe deform N16 33.08, linear N32 21.12 GiB (no recipe flags). Per-N table (timed, fitted): N2 default (no knobs) 32.45/37.31 F; N3 default LS 34.26/39.40 D; N4 f0d1 LS 34.99/40.24 D; N5-8 none. Skip-gradient bound: N3 default LS 35.89, N4 f0d1 LS 36.34/41.80. Fwd bound: N4 f0d1 LLS 34.99. PRE-FIT per-N (initial coefficients): N2 default 34.64/39.83 F, N3 default LS 32.96/37.90 D, N4 f0d1 LS 33.60/38.65 D, N>=5 none (= design 2.5 / 4.4). Step-time model (pre-measurement, x0.5..x1.5): RTX 8000 l1 deform 11.4-34.3 s (22.8), l1 linear 0.5-1.6 s, l2 deform 3.4-10.2, l4 deform 1.8-5.4; A100 = x r_task; m7 consistency ratio 1.12 -> r_task kept; level-1 long run RTX 8000 13.8-41.3 h (< 72 h). Note: the FLOP model gives l1 linear ~1.1 s (design hand estimate 5-9 s): at level 1 L2 runs at V1/8 with f0d1, so the conv FLOPs are ~level-2 size; memory-bound ops are not modelled; replaced by measured step_ms after the m9 job. PRINT-ENV: EXTRA_ARGS="--filters 16,64,128,192,256,384 --decoder-widths 128,96,64,32,8 --integration-steps 7 --amp true --gradient-checkpointing full --lean-sampler true --lean-losses false --split-group-conv true" N=16 DEFORM_N=4 / WIDTHS="f0d1,default,fr50" / KNOBS="--lean-sampler true --lean-losses false --split-group-conv true". MODEL-FORM / DESIGN CORRECTIONS (documented in the module and test docstrings): (1) RESIDENT: design U16 (lazily created Adam slots, linear-only records without deform-decoder slots) is contradicted by the code: Trainer.__init__ calls runtime/optimizers.build_optimizer(opt, model.trainable_variables), which builds slots for ALL trainable variables; the GTX resident_mb (411 MB default deform-only) also matches all-slot (~400 MB) not touched-only (~310 MB). Implemented: 12 B (fp32 weight + 2 slots) x all trainable + 4 B gradient (+2 B AMP fp16 cast) x touched parts + 4 B x frozen params (1 frozen copy for frozen4, 2 for chain42). Consequence: the design 2.3 linear pre-fit table is reproduced after adding the deform-decoder slot term (8 B x 7.14 M = 0.053 GiB) at the unchanged 0.05 GiB tolerance; the 4.6 bullet 'linear-only resident excludes the deform decoder's slots' is tested as 'excludes its gradient + fp16 cast, includes its slots'; the six level-2 deform pin rows stay within 0.1 GiB (they moved by -0.05 / -0.07 GiB). (2) The f0d1 LS N4 pin is tested at 33.6 +-0.1 (the design's own component sum 172+55+490+170+384 = 1271 B = 8.15 GiB/img -> 33.60; the 33.5 headline rounds 8.13 GiB/img); Fw 32.06, Fb 25.47, fwd bound 41.05, LLS bound 35.00, skip bound 34.96 all inside the design pins. (3) Z (frozen inference) is part of peak_gib (it runs inside the measured step); feasibility (b) holds automatically. (4) D sub-phases keep the whole recomputed decoder tape alive (needed for the level-2 'both' pins; at level 1 it does not change the D1-bound result). (5) Default-sampler sampler bytes count as class 'warp' (c_warp), lean-sampler retained/moment bytes as 'other' (uncalibrated, coefficient 1) until the hold-out records test them; loss-term composition follows design 2.1 exactly (lean term after-bytes: one-hot output 4C + Dice slices 8(C-1), image output 4 + LNCC 168 (8 with lean losses); target slice 4(C-1)). (6) Design 4.4 example 'val_pair_chunk 4' differs: the stated rule (largest chunk in {16,8,4,2,1} that fits 44 GiB with margin) picks 16 (effective 12 pairs, 33.9 GiB). (7) Level-1 linear peak 13.5 GiB vs design 12.7 (not pinned). CLI USAGE: `python scripts/memory_model.py fit [--calibration models/memory_calibration.json] [--out models/memory_coefficients.json] [--tensor-limits tensor_limit.json] [--no-lomo]` (exit 1 on any ok point outside +-15 %, OOM predicted feasible, failed_d2 unflagged or range above its upper end); `predict --level 1 --task deform --n 4 --widths f0d1 --amp true --checkpointing full --lean-sampler true --split-group-conv true --cascade chain42 --tasks-run rigid,affine,deform [--margin m] [--skip-grad-bound] [--fwd-transient-bound] [--json]`; `grid [--level 1] [--margin 0.15] [--out grid.json]` (672 deform rows + 56 linear rows + frozen-chain cost per N); `recommend [--n-target 4] [--margin m] [--t6-verdict .agents/tasks/milestone-9/integration_steps.json] [--print-env] [--out .agents/tasks/milestone-9/recommendation.json]` (exit 3 = R3.7 verdict, 4 = hold-out gate failed). Python API for FEAT-003 (measurement tool): `from models import memory_model as MM; p = MM.predict(MM.Workload(level, task, n, model_config, checkpointing, amp, integration_steps, lncc=..., lean_sampler=..., lean_losses=..., split_group_conv=..., cascade='none'|'frozen4'|'chain42', val_pair_chunk=..., build_n=..., gpu=...), MM.load_coefficients('models/memory_coefficients.json'))` -> p['peak_gib'] (x1024 = predicted_peak_mb), p['peak_phase'], p['largest_tensor']['elements'/'desc'], p['limit_flags']; Workload.from_record(record) builds it from a calibration-style dict (model_config dict or preset name; 'narrow'/'tiny' must be passed as explicit dicts with deform_decoder true). step_times_from_metrics.py: `--runs <dirs> --min-step 1000 --extra-keys diag_u_res_max_vox --args-keys a,b --out x.json` reads <run>/logs/metrics.jsonl ({step,time,data}), skips event records, always exits 0.
